source_title: Michael Douglas Gives Rare Update on Friend Jack Nicholson: ‘He Has Disappeared’ - People.com
source_excerpt:
“He is up there by his house and walking around in his slippers,” the actor claimed of his longtime friend
During an Oct. 26 event to discuss his new memoir, Michael Douglas provided a rare update on Jack Nicholson
Nicholson, who has largely avoided public appearances since his final film role in 2010, is doing well, according to Douglas
The longtime friends have never worked on-screen together, but Douglas produced the award-winning One Flew Over the Cuckoo’s Nest
Michael Douglas has a rare update on Jack Nicholson ’s life outside of Hollywood.
During a recent appearance in Swansea, Wales, to discuss his new memoir One Helluva Ride , the Wall Street star, 82, admitted he wished that he and Nicholson, 89, would have had a chance to work together on-screen.
“I would have liked to have acted with Jack,” Douglas said at the Monday, Oct. 26 event, The Independent reported. “He’s not working any more. He’s well. He has disappeared. I know that.”
“I still see him, but he is fine. He is up there by his house and walking around in his slippers. It happens. He deserves it. I understand. He is a few years older than me, but I understand,” he added of The Shining star.
Nicholson is seldom seen in public, and his last film was 2010’s How Do You Know .
Nicholson and Douglas’ friendship dates back decades, beginning when Douglas produced their career-defining film, One Flew Over the Cuckoo’s Nest in 1975.
In the years since, Douglas has praised Nicholson’s work on the movie, telling The Guardian in 2017 that “Jack encouraged everyone to bring their A-game.”
He added, “When you look at that baseball scene , with him rallying all the patients to watch the game on TV, that’s just his inherent nature.”

One Flew Over the Cuckoo’s Nest was nominated for nine Oscars, winning five: Best Picture, Best Director, Best Actor, Best Actress and Best Adapted Screenplay.
Nicholson last made a rare public appearance in February 2025 when he introduced Adam Sandler from the audience at the SNL50: The Anniversary Special event.
Prior to that, he was last spotted at an April 2023 Los Angeles Lakers playoff game, where he was seen hugging and shaking hands with LeBron James .
